name: dsh-plugin-paper
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: legitimate academic full-text acquisition. Multi-source search (OpenAlex/Crossref/arXiv/zbMATH), open-access resolution (Unpaywall/OpenAlex locations/arXiv), three-level fetch degradation with local PDF extraction (pdftotext/pypdf), citation verification against hallucination, and a local acquisition ledger. Pirate mirrors are refused by policy, including after redirects.
